notes: Security groups: every page is built for one user who holds the groups its fields and buttons need (salesman, invoicing, purchase user, tender manager), without developer mode (base.group_no_one), multi-company or multi-currency. Fieldia has no per-user groups: an app would serve a page per user, or Fieldia would need a `groups`-like condition on what the viewing user may see.
Help: Flectra shows a field's help as a tooltip on its label; Fieldia writes it under the field. The longest helps on the busiest groups were left out of the pages so they read like Flectra's.
Expressions: Flectra's tuples, `x in (a, b)`, are not read; Fieldia's lists, `x in [a, b]`, are. Translated by hand.

Sizes: `size` counts the Flectra view as seen with the inherited views listed (fields include the invisible technical ones; conditions are invisible/readonly/required attributes that are expressions). `built` counts the Fieldia page.

Placeholders: a node's placeholder was shown by text, number and date boxes, but not by a many2one, a many2many or an html field, which always said “Search…” or nothing; fixed since, so Flectra's “Company Name...”, “e.g. Mister”, “Internal notes...” and the tags' examples show (the contact's e2e).
